module: 'JBeam Picker' window of the live Vehicle Editor: lets you choose nodes and beams of the vehicle (with the mouse, or by typing an ID/name with suggestions) and follow their data live. 'Nodes' / 'Beams' tab: tree of the chosen elements, choice of the data to display (node: velocity, relative velocity, force; beam: length, speed, force, stress, damping), filter by beam type (NORMALTYPE, BEAM_ANISOTROPIC, BEAM_BOUNDED, BEAM_PRESSURED, BEAM_LBEAM, BEAM_BROKEN, BEAM_HYDRO, BEAM_SUPPORT) and graphs (1000 points). Picking uses the game's Node/Beam debug modes (Ctrl+M / Ctrl+B).
notes: The beam type values (0 to 7) correspond to the C++ engine constants and must not be changed.

The dynamic data (force, velocity, stress...) is requested from the vehicle VM via be:queueObjectFastLua and returned in the tables M.nodeDataFromVELua[id][name] and M.beamDataFromVELua[id][name] by obj:queueGameEngineLua; it therefore arrives one frame late and is 0 before the first reply.
The graphs advance by one sample per frame only when the simulation is running (be:getEnabled()).

nodeDataFromVELua.desc: Node data returned by the vehicle VM, keyed by node ID then data name (e.g. force).

beamDataFromVELua.desc: Beam data returned by the vehicle VM, keyed by beam ID then data name (speed, force, stress, damping).

requestDrawnNodesCallback.desc: Callback of the drawn-nodes request: remembers the list of nodes available for picking and their display scale (selection radius = 2 x scale).

requestDrawnBeamsCallback.desc: Callback of the drawn-beams request: remembers the available beams and their scale (selection radius = 5 x scale).

onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams.desc: Render hook emitted by editor_veMain: draws the chosen elements and runs the node or beam picking depending on the state.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: draws the Nodes/Beams tabbed window and advances the graph offset.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called at editor initialization: creates the beam type checkboxes.
